name: Knights of the Green Stone
description: A group of magi who believe the romances conceal the true story of the Grail and seek clues to a great artifact.

name: Celeres of Bonisagus
description: A Bonisagus magus living at Cunfin who strives to live by the chivalric ideals of the romances; next in seniority for Praeco after Renita, which worries Proctor.

name: Salvirius
description: A subtle faerie courtier of the Boar King who can teach Virtues, including Diedne Magic, to the Boar King's magus allies.

name: The Boar King
description: A faerie once worshiped by the Gauls who dwells in a wooden fortress in a Faerie regio (aura 7) and claims the forests of the Normandy Tribunal; a former ally of House Diedne.

name: Hill of Martyrs
description: A hill in Paris to which Salvirius asks a magus to deliver a sealed message.

name: Paris
description: Enormous city and seat of the French royal court; a center of culture and vice where many Normandy magi obtain exotic supplies.

name: River Seine
description: River through Normandy and Paris; site of the Ships of Flame regiones and of Confluensis' earlier site and Dragon's Rest.

name: Diedne Magic
description: Major Hermetic Virtue that Salvirius can teach; acquiring it brings the Dark Secret Story Flaw.

name: Dark Secret
description: Major Story Flaw acquired alongside Diedne Magic; also gained by characters in Jerome's child-rescue network.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic magical defense that scrying effects must overcome.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A magical link used for scrying; a twin brother forms one to a magus.

name: Major Hermetic Virtue
description: Category of Virtue, e.g. Diedne Magic and Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic.

name: Faerie Regio
description: Regiones where faerie knights and the Boar King's court dwell.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural region with its own aura, e.g. the Boar King's fortress and the Ships of Flame.

name: The Grail
description: The object of the romance quest, a physical object in early romances and a symbol of spiritual perfection in later ones.

name: Perceval
description: Chretien's romance in which the Grail was first introduced to the literature.

name: Chretien
description: Author of the romance Perceval, which introduced the Grail.

name: Faerie Knights
description: Faerie knights who stand at crossroads in romance-style regiones and accompany the Boar King.

name: Children of Odin
description: A new, secretive Mystery Cult led by Queen Skuld claiming the heritage of Viking magic and seeking to restore Normandy to Norman rule.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: The Tribunal covering northern France whose forests the Boar King claims and whose politics the chapter describes.

name: House Diedne
description: Fallen Hermetic House that once allied with the Boar King and was destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Schism War
description: The war in which House Diedne fell; Confluensis was sacked by Diedne magi during it.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic House whose magi the Boar King hopes to recruit; Pernix of Merinita is one member.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose magi the Boar King hopes to recruit; Renita Bjornaer belonged to it.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator and judge; Confluensis is dominated by Quaesitores.

name: Hoplite
description: Magi who enforce Hermetic justice alongside Quaesitores.

name: Cult of the Boar King
description: A newly revived pagan cult attempting to re-consecrate a temple to the Boar King.

name: Faerie Might
description: Measure of a faerie's power; the Boar King has Faerie Might 40 (Animal).

name: Voice of the Woods
description: Boar King power letting him converse with and command woodland creatures and plants.

name: Sylvan Sanctity
description: Boar King power revealing the location and number of human intruders in his forest.

name: Ancient Rage
description: Boar King power that sends him into a frothing fury with bonuses to Attack and Soak.

name: Impaled by the Thorn
description: Boar King power: a hurled boar spear that paralyzes and suspends aging of its target.

name: Call of the Hunter
description: Boar King power to appear anywhere in his forest.

name: Forest Paths
description: Mysteries of forest guardianship (from Guardians of the Forests) that the Boar King mimics to entice magi.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Hermetic tradition with secret modifications to theory revealed through Initiation.

name: Queen Skuld
description: Hierophant and Mystagogue of the Children of Odin; formerly a Tytalus maga of Atramentum who joined Ex Miscellanea, vanished toward Scandinavia, and returned in 1205.

name: Hierophant
description: Leader of a Mystery Cult; Queen Skuld is the Children of Odin's Hierophant.

name: Mystagogue
description: Cult member who conducts Initiations of others.

name: Rollo
description: Viking earl who captured Normandy in 911; Skuld claims descent from him.

name: Philip II
description: King of France, called Augustus, who annexed Normandy and rules with divine mandate; target of several plots.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic House possibly favored by the Children of Odin for Ignem; home of the milites.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire; cult members need a good Ignem score.

name: Montverte
description: Normandy covenant with Scandinavian founders that holds lands through a knight companion and has contacts in the Hanse Parisienne.

name: Initiation Script
description: Special Laboratory Text containing instructions for a Mystery Initiation.

name: Life Boost
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue granted by Children of Odin Initiation Scripts.

name: Minor Magical Focus
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue (Shape-shifting) granted by Children of Odin scripts.

name: Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
description: Major Hermetic Virtue granted by Children of Odin scripts.

name: Blood Haze
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw: the maga is crazed by bloodshed, penalizing Formulaic magic and Concentration in combat.

name: Flawed Parma Magica
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw (Vim) possibly gained as a Children of Odin Ordeal.

name: Deficient Technique
description: Major Hermetic Flaw (Creo) possibly gained as a Children of Odin Ordeal.

name: Concentration
description: Ability penalized by the Blood Haze Flaw.

name: Ships of Flame
description: Three perpetually burning Viking longships in Magic regiones (aura 6) on the Seine; Skuld's laboratory is on one.

name: Perdo Ignem
description: Technique/Form combination that might extinguish the Ships of Flame's fire.

name: Haunt of the Living Ghost
description: Spell Queen Skuld uses to communicate with cult members.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of conflict whose domus magna is Fudarus; currently split between two rival Primi, Harpax and Buliste.

name: Atramentum
description: Covenant where Skuld once resided as a Tytalus maga.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House Skuld joined in 1178.

name: Order of Odin
description: Northern rune-wielding magical tradition whose secrets the Children of Odin claim.

name: Initiation
description: Process by which Mystery Cults reveal knowledge via Quest, Ordeal and Virtue.

name: Ordeal
description: Part of Initiation in which the Initiate gains a Flaw.

name: Nordic Triumph
description: MuMe(He)(Te) 65 ritual turning a ship into a dragon-prowed longship and its crew into Viking warriors.

name: Hermetic Sigil
description: Magical signature of a magus, which can be shrouded.

name: Rune Magic
description: Magic of the Order of Odin that might be integrated into the Children of Odin's repertoire.

name: Holy Oil of Consecration
description: Holy oil of anointing for French kings, target of several plots, kept at Reims.

name: Carolingians
description: Frankish royal dynasty; German nobles plot to restore one to the French throne.

name: Capetians
description: Ruling French dynasty whose succession plotters hope to break.

name: Merovech
description: Ancestor of the Merovingians whose blood may carry kingship and supernatural powers.

name: Merovingian Dynasty
description: Frankish dynasty whose descendants may carry the legacy of the Quinotaur.

name: Bayeux Tapestry
description: Tapestry at Bayeux that Skuld wants to aid Penetration on a spell against the French king.

name: Bayeux
description: Norman town housing the Bayeux Tapestry in its cathedral.

name: Twilight
description: Wizard's Twilight, which can derange magi and caused Kybella's vision and constraints on Buliste.

name: Primus
description: Leader of a Hermetic House.

name: Reims Cathedral
description: Cathedral where the holy oil is kept.

name: Tribunal
description: Hermetic regional meeting where votes and cases are decided.

name: Charlemagne
description: Frankish emperor; the German nobles' candidate traces ancestry to him; subject of trouveres' tales.

name: Pope Stephen II
description: Pope whose ruling about a 'seven generations' reprieve German nobles misunderstand.

name: St. Clotilde
description: Wife of Clovis I; patron of the lame, invoked against sudden death and iniquitous husbands.

name: Clovis I
description: First Christian Merovingian king.

name: St. Martin of Tours
description: Fourth-century soldier turned monk then bishop who gave half his cloak to a beggar.

name: St. Remi
description: Bishop of Reims, Apostle of the Franks, who baptised Clovis I.

name: St. Riquier
description: Seventh-century pagan converted by Irish missionaries who became a bishop then hermit.

name: St. Valery
description: Sixth-century shepherd turned monk and hermit near Amiens.

name: St. Vedast
description: Bishop of Arras who prepared Clovis I for baptism; depicted with a wolf and goose.

name: St. Louis
description: Louis IX, currently 5 years old, who historically ascends in 1226 and is canonized in 1297.

name: Divine
description: Realm of Power whose encroachment the Boar King resents.

name: Cunfin
description: Covenant associated with a Cistercian monastery; a vassal of Confluensis and home of Celeres and Eloi.

name: Florum
description: Mercantile covenant censured in 1088 for upsetting the local economy; rival of Fudarus.

name: Cistercian Order
description: Powerful monastic order with which Cunfin and Eloi are associated.

name: Écuage
description: Payment in lieu of a knight's military service.

name: Common Law
description: Ability best representing Normandy's legal system based on Frankish Tribal Law.

name: Civil Law
description: Roman-based legal system used in the Provençal Tribunal.

name: Provençal Tribunal
description: Southern French Tribunal using Civil Law.

name: Trouvere
description: Romantic troubadours of the Normandy Tribunal who sing tales of Charlemagne and Arthur.

name: King Arthur
description: Legendary king whose tales are sung by trouveres; Pellinore claims he was a Welsh chieftain-magician.

name: Knight Errant
description: Young knights who ride in search of adventure like heroes of the romances.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Hermetic House with ties to nobility and many agents in the Church; Jerome and Eloi belong to it.

name: Purifying Touch
description: Ability displayed by the Merovingian boy apprenticed by a Jerbiton maga.

name: The Gift
description: The capacity for magic; a Merovingian descendant might manifest it.

name: Quinotaur
description: Legendary creature whose supernatural legacy passes to Merovingian descendants.

name: Peregrinator
description: Wandering maga type from Guardians of the Forests.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal where a Merovingian-descended Ex Miscellanea maga lives.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Hermetic law including the clause against bringing ruin on sodales.

name: Grand Tribunal
description: Order-wide Tribunal that ruled in 865 against court wizards and in 1061 limited sales of magic items; held at Durenmar.

name: Court Wizard
description: Magus bound as a vassal employee of a mundane lord, forbidden by the 865 Grand Tribunal ruling.

name: Iola of Guernicus
description: Magus who in 1047 distinguished court wizards as vassals rather than economic dependents.

name: House Verditius
description: Magi who argued against deeming economic relationships inadmissible.

name: Consors
description: An acknowledged asset of the covenant, as which a companion lord may receive magical support.

name: Infelicitas
description: Covenant whose laboratories were destroyed in a raid, ruled illegal in 1130.

name: Pernix of Merinita
description: Magus acquitted in 1179 after covertly healing a young nobleman.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi, of which most nobles are aware.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power harvested from sources.

name: Peripheral Code
description: Normandy Tribunal's local legal rulings, which covenants may try not to infringe.

name: Dominion
description: Divine aura spreading with farmland that impairs magic and corrodes vis sites and wards.

name: Eboris
description: Paris covenant, the Ivory Carvers, senex of Paris with influence among the city's seedy districts and Byzantine émigrés.

name: Oleron
description: Self-sufficient covenant censured for trying to rescue Eleanor of Aquitaine; recruits sailors from Oleron island.

name: Henry II
description: English king who warred with Philip II; both offered concessions to magi.

name: Eleanor of Aquitaine
description: Queen whom Oleron attempted to rescue from captivity.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose chief Quaesitor censured Oleron; most Cabal of the Crushed Viper members come from it.

name: Masks
description: Disposable mundane agents acting on behalf of a covenant.

name: Confluensis
description: Largest Quaesitorial covenant in Normandy, in the Cotentin swamps, built as giant stone flowers to maintain balance between covenants.

name: University of Paris
description: University whose law faculty has contacts with Confluensis.

name: Fudarus
description: Domus magna of House Tytalus, controlling the Parisian Dyer's Guild; its resources are controlled by Harpax.

name: Dyer's Guild
description: Small Parisian guild infiltrated by Fudarus, producing magically enhanced dyes.

name: Jon Baudin
description: Guildmaster of the Dyer's Guild and Fudarus spy who plays two Daniel impersonators against each other.

name: Daniel
description: Tytalus magus who died six years ago; Fudarus factions impersonate him.

name: Hanse Parisienne
description: Principal merchants' league of Paris with Montverte contacts.

name: Anacron
description: Eremite magus who has collaborated with Montverte on raids on covenants' Paris storehouses.

name: Senex
description: Status of Eboris in Paris granting it the right to pursue sponsors of masks.

name: Vassalage
description: Hermetic system in which weak covenants pay strong lieges for protection.

name: Corruption of House Tytalus
description: Historic demonic corruption of House Tytalus under Tasgillia.

name: Demon of Vendée
description: Demon trapped by a Magical ward in a sea cave at Vendée.

name: Vendée
description: Coastal region with rocky promontories where a demon is trapped.

name: Cabal
description: Clandestine anonymous Tytalus organizations formed to achieve specific goals.

name: Cabal of the Laden Cart
description: Tytalus cabal founded by Kybella to entrap Death, obsessed with the Ankeu.

name: Kybella of Tytalus
description: Tytalus maga of Exspectatio whose Twilight vision of Death led her to found the Cabal of the Laden Cart.

name: Exspectatio
description: Covenant of Kybella and Adanos Lutorum.

name: Ankeu
description: Spirit of Death that haunts Brittany with a creaking cart.

name: Brittany
description: Region with hundreds of mottes and castles, haunted by the Ankeu.

name: Cabal of the Crushed Viper
description: Tytalus cabal opposing the chivalric ideal, members taking Arthurian pseudonyms.

name: William Marshal
description: Prominent English noble renowned at tourney who led attacks on the Welsh.

name: Lancelot (cabal member)
description: Cabal of the Crushed Viper member who befriends and betrays Flambeau milites.

name: Vivian (cabal member)
description: Faerie-hating cabal member who targets troubadours.

name: Pellinore (cabal member)
description: Cabal member claiming descent from the real Arthur who manipulates churchmen against tournaments.

name: Milites
description: Society of honor-bound knight-magi within House Flambeau.

name: Hermetic Tourney
description: Hermetic tournament of the Normandy Tribunal, reported by the Evangelium.

name: Harpax
description: Tytalus Primus contesting leadership with his sister Buliste; controls Fudarus' resources and leads the Decimi.

name: Buliste
description: Elder sister and rival Prima of Tytalus, controlling House spy networks; leads the Fideli.

name: Decimi
description: Tytali loyal to Harpax who wear the tenth Primus' sigil.

name: Fideli
description: Tytali loyal to Buliste's purple banner.

name: Rod of the Primus
description: Item giving control of the Fudarus building itself.

name: Wizard's War
description: Formal Hermetic war, which the Tytalus Primi feud avoids.

name: Durenmar
description: Location of the Forum of Hermes where the Grand Tribunal meets.

name: Forum of Hermes
description: Chamber at Durenmar where Primi sit at Grand Tribunal.

name: Porphyrion of Tytalus
description: Powerful Archmage and eremite from the Rome Tribunal, a possible third contender for Tytalus Primus.

name: Rome Tribunal
description: Tribunal Porphyrion moved from.

name: Archmage
description: Title of a powerful magus such as Porphyrion.

name: Cotentin Peninsula
description: Peninsula nearly cut off by swamps where Confluensis hides.

name: Dragon's Rest
description: Mercer House vassal of Confluensis on its original Seine site, hub of the Tribunal's Mercere Portal network.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House of Quaesitores; Confluensis was founded on Guernicus' instructions and serves its Primus.

name: House Mercere
description: House of Redcaps; its magi retained Dragon's Rest.

name: Mercer House
description: A Redcap covenant such as Dragon's Rest.

name: Gargouille
description: Dragon whose lair in the Seine swamps was Confluensis' original site, now Dragon's Rest.

name: Orchard of Sour Apples
description: Island (the Orchard) northeast of Coutances, once a vassal covenant, with an Intellego vis orchard of sour apples.

name: Tasgillia
description: Diabolic Prima of Tytalus cast down by the Order.

name: Terrae Cult
description: Terram-focused cult tradition within House Guernicus, possibly colonizers of Confluensis.

name: Mont Saint Michel
description: Abbey whose quarry stone resembles Confluensis' buildings.

name: Great Hall (Confluensis)
description: Largest pad of the Sundew at Confluensis, with dining, training and storage.

name: The Sundew
description: Enormous stone sundew sculpture supporting most of Confluensis' buildings.

name: Pad of Gatherers
description: Confluensis pad housing food producers.

name: Pad of Crafters
description: Confluensis pad home to tradesmen, ceramicists and paper makers.

name: Pad of Parades
description: Open pad used for events, Aegis rituals and Tribunal meetings.

name: Furled Pad
description: Unfurled pad used as mooring point.

name: Bell Flower
description: Bell-shaped stone flower supporting Confluensis magi's residences.

name: Library Tower
description: Oldest structure of Confluensis with council chamber, library and Mercere Portal.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Covenant protective ritual performed on the Pad of Parades.

name: Mercere Portal
description: Magical portal linking Confluensis, Dragon's Rest, Cunfin, Harco and others.

name: Venelli
description: Celtic tribe whose remnants are Confluensis' covenfolk, with an ancient pact with swamp powers.

name: Jersey
description: Channel Island where Venelli relics and mercenary graves may be found.

name: Ship of the Dead
description: Ship leaving Le Havre each All Hallows Night carrying drowned sailors' souls to Hell under a terrible Captain.

name: Le Havre
description: Port from which the Ship of the Dead departs.

name: White Lady
description: Local faerie who may be sent as emissary to Confluensis.

name: Coutances
description: Former Venelli capital, burned by Normans in 998.

name: Magic Aura
description: Confluensis' powerful aura from its fresh/salt water location.

name: Intellego
description: Technique; Intellego vis is found in the Orchard's apples.

name: Renita Bjornaer
description: Praeco and leader of Confluensis who died last winter, causing a succession crisis.

name: Praeco
description: Eldest magus presiding over a Tribunal.

name: Proctor
description: Ruthless Presiding Quaesitor of Normandy and leader of Confluensis, distrustful of Tytalus; his talisman is a fool's cap bell.

name: Presiding Quaesitor
description: Quaesitor presiding at Tribunal.

name: Jerome of Confluensis
description: Jerbiton magus, Tribunal liaison to French nobility who secretly rescues 'troublesome heirs'.

name: Eloi of Cunfin
description: Pious Jerbiton magus of Cunfin, Jerome's filius, liaison to the Church.

name: The Traitor
description: Voluntary exile from House Tytalus obliged to restart the House's stalled conflicts; bears a magical key.

name: Promethea
description: First Traitor, filia of Kalliste, who waited out the struggle against Tasgillia and became a Quaesitor.

name: Kalliste
description: Mater of Promethea.

name: Magvillius
description: Place Promethea went to await the end of the struggle.

name: Analects of Tytalus
description: Tytalus text judging Promethea's waiting a moral error.

name: Traitor's Key
description: Magical key borne by the Traitor since Tasgillia, rumored to weaken Fudarus' defenses.

name: Aristarcus
description: Filius of Proctor, a Traditionalist Guernicus who argues cases before Tribunal; familiar a swan.

name: Transitionalist
description: Guernicus position held by Proctor and Cavillor.

name: Traditionalist
description: Guernicus position held by Aristarcus.

name: Richard the Devil
description: Figure whose penance bell Proctor believes his talisman to be.

name: Fool's Cap Bell
description: Proctor's talisman, a brass bell enchanted against Infernal influence.

name: Cavillor
description: Young Transitionalist Guernicus from the Roman Tribunal who defends accused magi.

name: Valerian
description: Chief hoplite of Normandy, Terram master reputed to be in the Terrae cult, with an invisible spirit familiar.

name: Adanos Lutorum
description: Magus of Exspectatio reputed to belong to the Guernicus Terrae cult.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth; Valerian is a known master.

name: Wizard's March
description: Hermetic outlawry; the chief hoplite handles military planning.

name: Artorius
description: Gifted child rescued by Jerome.

name: William the Bastard
description: Who disappeared eight years in childhood before claiming Normandy then England.

name: Treasures of Britain
description: Legendary set including a magical chessboard sought by Jerome.

name: Augustina of Tytalus
description: Current Traitor, trained by Buliste's mater, serving as a hoplite at Confluensis.

name: Harco
description: Covenant connected to the Mercere Portal network.

name: Evangelium
description: Normandy Tribunal officer, always a Redcap, reporting Tourney results.

name: Myrina
description: Current Evangelium, living at Dragon's Rest.

name: Redcap
description: Members of House Mercere who travel and carry messages.

name: Stellatus
description: Renita's sept-mate who left for Iberia.

name: Somnifer of Lapis Crudus
description: Candidate for Praeco.

name: Lapis Crudus
description: Covenant of Somnifer.

name: Geirlaug of Montverte
description: Possible Praeco candidate.

name: Lotharingian Tribunal
description: Tribunal with a pro-Lotharingian faction.

name: Pro-Lotharingian Faction
description: Magi retaining Cavillor as legal advisor.

name: Familiar
description: Magical animal companion of a magus.

name: Talisman
description: Magus's personal enchanted item.

name: Longevity Potion
description: Potion keeping Aristarcus youthful.

name: Faerie
description: Realm of Power; aura of the Boar King's regio and formerly of the Orchard.

name: Magic
description: Realm of Power; the Ships of Flame are Magical regiones.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of demons; Proctor's talisman defends against it.
